events.title: The Demo is Live
events.summary: The wait is finally over! Room Service demo is now available on Steam!You can finally attend your first shift as a Night Shift Attendant at the Silver Pine Hotel. Your duties are simple: inspect the rooms, fill out nightly reports and most importantly... If you see anything move, leave immediately. events.title: Development Update: We're getting close
events.summary: Hello! We wanted to share a quick update on where development currently stands. Over the past 8 months, we’ve been working very hard on polishing the game, and we’re finally reaching the final stages of development.Here’s what we’ve been working on recently:Polishing the lobby (literally, I put a very shiny marble floors this time) Out of planned 20 rooms for this project, we now have around 35 out of 43 rooms completed (also my way of saying that we added way more rooms than originally planned)
